title: Sheep
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="24" fill="#f5f0e0"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="48" r="14" fill="#faf5e8"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="48" r="14" fill="#faf5e8"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="66" r="13" fill="#e8e0cc"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="66" r="13" fill="#e8e0cc"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="12" fill="#faf5e8"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="72" r="12" fill="#e8e0cc"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="72" r="12" fill="#e8e0cc"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="72" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#6b5b4a"/>
  <rect x="55" y="72" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#6b5b4a"/>
  <rect x="37" y="85" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#4a3f33"/>
  <rect x="54" y="85" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#4a3f33"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#d4c8b0"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="32" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#c4b8a0" transform="rotate(-25 36 32)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="32" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#c4b8a0" transform="rotate(25 64 32)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="32" r="2.8" fill="#2a2035"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="32" r="2.8" fill="#2a2035"/>
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="31.2" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55.8" cy="31.2" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#8a7a68"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M48 40 Q50 42 52 40" stroke="#7a6a58" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
